newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LOKO TAKES GOAL COUNT TO FIVE IN TWO GAMES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LOKO TAKES GOAL COUNT TO FIVE IN TWO GAMES.

text.p: European Cup Winners' Cup hat-trick hero Patrice Loko took his tally to five in two games with both goals in Paris St Germain's 2-0 win over Metz on Sunday.
The victory, with the France striker scoring in the 20th and 24th minutes, cut Monaco's French championship lead to seven points over second-placed PSG.
UEFA Cup semifinalists Monaco had opened a 10-point lead on Saturday after beating Bastia 3-1 at home.
Loko hit home a corner to the far post and four minutes later turned in a cross from the right by Jerome Leroy at the end of a move started by midfielder Vincent Guerin.
Metz, without injured French international Robert Pires, missed a good chance to reduce PSG's lead in the second half when goalkeeper Bernard Lama saved from striker Bruno Rodriguez.
It was PSG's second successive home victory after a worrying four-month run without winning at home.
Nantes climbed to third on Saturday as they extended their unbeaten run to 23 matches with a 1-0 home win over Lille
